Ax Battler - Golden Axe Densetsu.name: Ax Battler: A Legend of Golden Axe
Ax Battler - Golden Axe Densetsu.summary: Use your wits and your razor sharp sword to recapture the Golden Axe from the diabolical Death Adder. Defeat skeletons and giant bats in dark, deep chasms and caves. And summon Earth, Thunder and Fire Magic to fight gargoyles that come to life before your eyes!

Defenders of Oasis.name: Defenders of Oasis
Defenders of Oasis.summary: As the Prince, you must defend the world of Oasis from the dark forces in this challenging real-time role-playing game!
